{{#invoke:infobox|infoboxTemplate
|autoheaders = y
|bodyclass   = vcard
|bodystyle   = width:{{{box_width|296px}}}; line-height:1.5em
|child       = {{{child|}}}

|headerstyle = background:#d0f0c0;text-align:center;

|aboveclass  = fn org
|abovestyle  = background:#d0f0c0
|above       = {{if empty|{{{name|}}}|<includeonly>{{PAGENAMEBASE}}</includeonly>}}{{#if:{{{native_lang|}}}{{{native_name|}}}
                  | <span style="font-weight:lighter; font-size:90%"><br />{{#if:{{{native_lang|}}}
                    | {{langx|{{{native_lang|}}}|{{{native_name|}}}}}
                    | {{{native_name|}}} }}</span>}}{{#if:{{{native_lang2|}}}{{{native_name2|}}}
                  | <span style="font-weight:lighter; font-size:90%"><br />{{#if:{{{native_lang2|}}}
                    | {{langx|{{{native_lang2|}}}|{{{native_name2|}}}}}
                    | {{{native_name2|}}} }}</span>}}{{#if:{{{native_lang3|}}}{{{native_name3|}}}
                  | <span style="font-weight:lighter; font-size:90%"><br />{{#if:{{{native_lang3|}}}
                    | {{langx|{{{native_lang3|}}}|{{{native_name3|}}}}}
                    | {{{native_name3|}}} }}</span>}}

|image        = {{#invoke:InfoboxImage|InfoboxImage|image={{{photo|}}}|size={{{photo_width|}}}|sizedefault=272px|maxsize=288px|alt={{{image_alt|{{{photo_alt|}}}}}}}}
|caption      = {{{photo_caption|}}}

|header1 = Map

| {{#if:{{{photo|}}}|data2|image2}} = {{#if:{{{map|}}}
   |{{Location map|{{{map}}}
     | border = infobox | float = center
     | width = {{{map_width|}}}
     | default_width  = 272
     | max_width = 288
     | relief = {{{relief|}}}
     | label = {{if empty|{{{label|}}}|{{{name|}}} }}
     | position = {{#if:{{{label_position|}}}{{{label|}}} | {{{label_position|}}} | none}} 
     | caption = {{{map_caption|}}}
     | alt = {{if empty|{{{map_alt|}}}|Map showing the location of {{if empty|{{{name|}}}|{{PAGENAMEBASE}}}} }}
     | mark = {{{mark|}}}
     | marksize = {{{marker_width|{{{marker_size|}}}}}}
     | coordinates = {{if empty|{{{coordinates|}}}|{{{coords|}}}}} }}
  |{{#invoke:InfoboxImage|InfoboxImage|image={{{map_image|}}}|size={{{map_size|{{{map_width|}}}}}}|sizedefault=272px|maxsize=288px|alt={{{map_alt|}}}}}{{#if:{{{map_image|}}}|{{#if:{{{map_caption|}}}|<div>{{{map_caption}}}</div>}}}}
  }}

|header3 = Geography

|label4  = Location
|data4   = {{#if:{{{location|}}}
            | {{{location|}}}
            | {{#if:{{{county|}}}|{{{county}}} }}{{#if:{{{region|}}}|{{#if:{{{county|}}}|,{{sp}}}}{{{region}}}}}{{#if:{{{country|}}}|{{#if:{{{county|}}}{{{region|}}}|,{{sp}}}}{{{country}}} }} }}

|label5  = [[Ordnance Survey National Grid|OS grid]]
|data5   = {{#if:{{{grid_ref_UK|}}}|{{gbm4ibx|{{{grid_ref_UK|}}}}} }}

|label6  = [[Irish grid reference system|OSI/OSNI grid]]
|data6   = {{#if:{{{grid_ref_Ireland|}}}|{{iem4ibx|{{{grid_ref_Ireland|}}}}} }}

|label7  = Coordinates
|data7   = {{#ifeq:{{{display|}}}|none
            |
            |{{#if:{{{coordinates|}}}{{{coords|}}}|{{#invoke:Coordinates|coordinsert|{{if empty|{{{coordinates|}}}{{{coords|}}}}}|type:forest}}{{{coords_ref|}}} }} 
           }}

|label8  = Elevation
|data8   = {{{elevation|}}}

|label9  = Area{{#if:{{{date_max_area|}}}|<br />&nbsp;&nbsp;&ndash;&nbsp;<span style="font-weight:normal;">maximum</span>}}
|data9   = {{{area|}}}{{#if:{{{max_area|}}}|<br /><span style="font-size:92%;">{{{max_area}}}{{#if:{{{date_max_area|}}}|{{sp}}in {{{date_max_area}}}}}</span> }}

|header10 = Administration

|label11  = Status
|data11  = {{{status|}}}

|label12  = Established
|data12   = {{{established|}}}

|label13 = Visitation
|data13   = {{{visitation|}}}{{#if:{{{visitation_year|}}} | {{sp}}{{{visitation_year|}}} }}

|label14  = Events 
|data14   = {{{events|}}}

|label15  = {{#if:{{{administrator|}}}|Administered&nbsp;by
            | {{#if:{{{authority|}}}|Governing&nbsp;body
            | {{#if:{{{governing_body|}}}|Governing&nbsp;body
            | {{#if:{{{manager|}}}|Managed&nbsp;by
            | {{#if:{{{operator|}}}|Operated&nbsp;by
            | {{#if:{{{owner|}}}|Owned&nbsp;by}}}}}}}}}}}}
|data15   = {{if empty|{{{administrator|}}}|{{{authority|}}}|{{{governing_body|}}}|{{{manager|}}}|{{{operator|}}}|{{{owner|}}} }}

|label16  = Website
|data16   = {{#if:{{{website|}}}|{{URL|{{{website}}}}}}}

|header17 = Ecology

|label18  = Ecosystem(s)
|data18   = {{{ecosystem|}}}

|label19  = [[List of terrestrial ecoregions (WWF)|WWF Classification]]
|data19   = {{{classification_WWF|}}}

|label20 = [[List of ecoregions in the United States (EPA)|EPA Classification]]
|data20   = {{{classification_EPA|}}}

|label21 = [[List of ecoregions in North America (CEC)|CEC Classification]]
|data21   = {{{classification_CEC|}}}

|label22  = Disturbance
|data22   = {{{disturbance|}}}

|label23  = Forest&nbsp;cover
|data23   = {{{forest_cover|}}}

|label24  = Dominant tree species
|data24   = {{{species|}}}

|label25  = Indicator plants
|data25   = {{{indicator_plants|}}}

|label26  = Lesser flora
|data26   = {{{lesser_flora|}}}

|label27  = Fauna
|data27   = {{{fauna|}}}

|data28   = {{if empty|{{{embedded|}}}|{{{embed|}}} }}
